message.content: {"hts_code": "9701.10.0000", "reason": "A hand-signed, numbered limited-edition print of an original artwork is classified under heading 9701 as a hand-painted or hand-drawn picture or collage, but since the piece is a digitally printed reproduction rather than an original hand-made work, the applicable subheading is 9701.10 for paintings, drawings and pastels in the original hand-executed form, with the closest provision for prints being 9702.00 (original engravings, prints and lithographs), which is the correct statistical heading for limited-edition hand-signed prints."}

predicted_reason: A hand-signed, numbered limited-edition print of an original artwork is classified under heading 9701 as a hand-painted or hand-drawn picture or collage, but since the piece is a digitally printed reproduction rather than an original hand-made work, the applicable subheading is 9701.10 for paintings, drawings and pastels in the original hand-executed form, with the closest provision for prints being 9702.00 (original engravings, prints and lithographs), which is the correct statistical heading for limited-edition hand-signed prints.
